title: Mixing: Mrs Lennon by Yoko Ono | 1971
content:
Studio A, Record Plant, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono

A mixing session for Yoko Ono’s song ‘Mrs Lennon’ took place on 27 August 1971.

The song had been recorded the previous day, and featured Ono on vocals, John Lennon on piano and organ, and Klaus Voormann on acoustic guitar and bass guitar.

‘Mrs Lennon’ was released on 29 September 1971 as the lead single from Fly, Ono’s second album, with ‘Midsummer New York’ on the b-side.
